$comment: How the pack store groups packs, shared by the app's Packs screen and the website's pack catalog (copied there by the site's import-bundled script). A pack belongs to the field of its first domain; packs with no domain (toolkits) name their field in packFields. A field belongs to the category that lists its domain.
